name: Decision Map / 决策地图
description: Turn an evidence brief into a small decision map. / 将证据简报整理为可审阅的决策地图。
steps: List supported options. / 列出有依据的选项。
Attach evidence and uncertainty to each option. / 为每个选项标明依据和不确定性。
Define one reversible next step. / 设计一个可逆的下一步。
constraints: Do not invent supporting evidence. / 不编造支撑材料。
Ask a human to review the trade-offs. / 由人审阅取舍。
